source: FEA heel-strike calibration vs MuJoCo V10

v22_implications.fsm_risk: FSM phase timing tuned for 6.0 ms contact. Real hardware has ~0.93 ms contact (8.1x shorter). Post-impact velocity change is near-instantaneous in hardware -> FSM may misclassify phase if stance_early window < 0.93 ms.
v22_implications.recommendation:
1. Re-run V13.6/V16 with solref=(0.0007, 1.0) to check if FSM still works.
2. Add min_contact_force threshold (>50N) to touchdown detection instead of relying on contact boolean.
3. In V17 (sensor loop), use force sensor not just contact flag.
